These critical elements are: sustained winds averaging 15 mph or greater relative humidity 25 percent or less temperature 75°F or greater Red Flag Warning Red Flag Warnings are issued anytime there is an ongoing wildfire, or critical weather conditions will occur within the next 24 hours.
